parameters.name: Dimensions
parameters.description: A set of labels for the metric.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Default is the current time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the dataset acceleration instance that owns the metrics. To get an instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The type of metric. Valid values:

- NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond: Bytes received per second over the network.

- NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond: Bytes sent per second over the network.

- FrontendThroughputBytes: Frontend service throughput in bytes.

- FrontendLatencyMicrosecond: Frontend service latency in microseconds.

- FrontendIops: Frontend service read frequency (IOPS).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Default is one hour before now.
